name: LeafScans-Orchard
description: LeafScans-Orchard is a curated, multi-year RGB image dataset of orchard plant leaves designed to support research in computer vision, machine learning, and plant phenotyping. The dataset comprises 9708 high-quality leaf scans acquired during collection campaigns conducted between 2015 and 2025, covering seven orchard crop species: apple, pear, sweet cherry, sour cherry, plum, peach, and apricot. In total, the dataset includes 67 cultivar labels.
